outOfScope: Global scheduler, role registry or organization workflow graph.
Exactly-once event transport or transactional outbox as a correctness prerequisite.
Deployment, AcceptanceSnapshot or Product QA semantics.
Execution-policy or strategy selection inside the activation boundary.
constraints: Event or queue delivery is not lifecycle, claim or execution authority.
Activation is not strategy selection and is not obligation creation.
Queue, cursor and local backoff state are disposable and reconstructable from canonical work state.
A stale queued hint cannot resurrect invalidated work.
Frontend and Backend independence is governed by exact semantic dependencies, not global development stages.
A durable runtime such as Restate may host activation mechanics but cannot become organizational source of truth or hidden scheduler.
invariants: one domain outage must not block unrelated domain work
queued stale hints cannot resurrect invalidated work
architectureDecisions: Activation is level-triggered per owning domain; hints/scans only discover exact work and canonical state is reread before claim.
Key={projectId,workId,owningDomain}; trigger data grants no principal/claim/strategy/runtime/obligation/publication authority.
Canonical scans are recovery truth; disposable hint state cannot strand work; duplicates converge through claim/release + attempt currentness.
BB-052 must preserve requiredArtifactRefs and exact obligation-head currentness or BB-053 returns to RESEARCH_SA.
DomainExecutionInput is immutable content-addressed execution data; exactly one ref must match WorkContract owningDomain/workloadType.
DomainExecutionController resolves policy/strategy and passes exact WorkContract to its prebound adapter; activation never selects HOW.
BACKEND/FRONTEND have separate principals, hosts, controllers and adapters; shared stores provide CAS/currentness only.
Post-release reread of the same obligationSubjectKey+revision gates execution; drift fences claim with no attempt.
Parallel proof requires both FE/BE dispatch entered before either completes; host-local failure and exact invalidation cannot affect siblings.
implementationSlices: D1 — DomainExecutionInput bridge [AC-5,AC-6]. Files: add src/domain-execution-input.js; extend organization-artifact-store.js + index.js. Define immutable v1 schema {owningDomain,workloadType,repository:{ref,revision},requiredFiles[],constraints[]} and content-addressed ref. API: putDomainExecutionInput(raw), resolveDomainExecutionInput(ref), resolveWorkExecutionInput(contract) requiring exactly one requiredArtifactRef with matching owningDomain/workloadType. Zero/multiple/mismatch fails before runtime dispatch. Tests: frontend-domain, fe-be-parallel.

D2 — DomainExecutionController adapter seam [AC-2,AC-3,AC-4,INV-4]. File: src/domain-execution-control.js. Change runtimeAdapter dispatch/recover input from {binding,input,runtimeInvocationKey} to {binding,contract,input,runtimeInvocationKey}, where contract is the exact immutable WorkContract resolved from the released claim. Keep executionPolicySubjectKey lookup, strategy descriptor resolution, attempt binding, release revalidation and runtime attestation authoritative in the controller. Activation cannot pass policy/strategy/adapter. Regression: bb048-domain-execution-control.

D3A — Discovery, restart recovery and duplicate convergence [AC-1,AC-2,AC-7,INV-1,INV-2,INV-3]. Files: add src/domain-activation-source.js + src/domain-activation.js. source.scan({owningDomain}) delegates to organization discovery listEligible. reconcile({projectId,workId,owningDomain}) always rereads canonical Board/WorkContract state before claim. Lost hints are recovered by later scans; concurrent scan+notify of one key converges through existing claim/release currentness and one execution-attempt subject, with duplicate path returning NOOP/replay. Tests: domain-activation, activation-recovery.

D3B — Exact domain/authority admission [AC-3,INV-1,INV-3,INV-4,INV-5]. File: src/domain-activation.js. Before claimController.claim/reconcile, require key.owningDomain === configured host domain === resolved WorkContract.owningDomain. Notify payload is reduced to exact key only; principal comes from configured trusted principal context, obligation from WorkContract provenance, and policy/strategy/runtime from DomainExecutionController. Domain mismatch returns REJECTED/NOOP with claim calls=0, attempt store unchanged, runtime dispatch=0. Tests: domain-activation + bb047 organization regression.

D3C — Post-release obligation currentness fence [AC-4,INV-8]. Files: src/domain-activation.js + organization-claim integration only through existing public invalidation/release APIs. Capture exact {obligationSubjectKey,revision,status:ACTIVE} from the WorkContract-bound BB-052 currentness source before claim; after canonical release and immediately before execute, reread the same subject. Revision/status drift calls canonical exact-claim invalidation/fencing, returns NOOP, and creates no execution attempt or dispatch. Tests use a barrier between release and execute in partial-invalidation/domain-activation.

D3D — Selective activation invalidation [AC-8,INV-8]. File: src/domain-activation.js. A stale notify/reconcile whose exact obligation is non-current is suppressed by D3C and may fence only that released claim; activation never invokes organization-wide or stage reset. A second work item with a different ACTIVE obligation remains returned by source.scan and can claim/execute in the same fixture. Tests: partial-invalidation + activation-recovery.

D4 — Backend execution strategy adapter [AC-5,AC-6]. File: add src/backend-execution-strategy.js. Factory createBackendExecutionStrategy({organizationArtifactRegistry,repositoryReader,backendWorker,completionPolicy}) returns adapter metadata plus dispatch/recover. Resolve exact matching DomainExecutionInput, map to BackendObjective {id:contract.boardItemId,task:contract.summary,repository,requiredFiles,constraints}, dispatch through prepareBackendObjective + runPreparedBackendObjective and recover through recoverPreparedBackendObjective. Map APPLIED/BLOCKED/FAILED -> SUCCEEDED/BLOCKED/FAILED, artifacts -> outputArtifactRefs, evidence -> verificationCandidateRefs, runtimeInvocationId=runtimeInvocationKey. Never call Backend->QA composite flow. Tests: frontend-domain/fe-be-parallel + existing Backend regression.

D5 — First autonomous Frontend domain [AC-5,AC-6,INV-6,INV-7]. Files: add src/frontend-contracts.js, frontend-completion.js, frontend-worker.js, frontend-application.js, frontend-execution-strategy.js; export via index.js. Define Frontend Objective/WorkOrder/Context/WorkResult with APPLIED|BLOCKED|FAILED; completion requires frontend.mutation, frontend.typecheck and frontend.tests evidence. Frontend application exposes prepare/runPrepared/recoverPrepared and strategy adapter uses the same controller result mapping as D4. Inputs are only exact Frontend WorkContract + matching DomainExecutionInput; no Backend stage/session/completion dependency. Tests: frontend-domain + fe-be-parallel.

D6A — DomainActivationHost lifecycle [AC-1,AC-2,AC-7,INV-2,INV-3]. File: add src/domain-activation-host.js. createDomainActivationHost({owningDomain,discovery,activation,scanIntervalMs,timer}) returns start,scanOnce,notify,stop. start is idempotent and launches an immediate scan then periodic scans; scanOnce calls listEligible(domain) then Promise.allSettled(reconcile(exactKey)); notify accepts only exact same-domain key as latency hint; stop cancels timer and drains only that host. No priority, nextRole, nextDomain or stage API. Tests: domain-host-autonomy + activation-recovery.

D6B — Independent FE/BE runtime composition [AC-5,AC-6,INV-6,INV-7]. File: add src/domain-runtime-composition.js. createFrontendBackendDomainRuntime({backendHost,frontendHost}) returns startAll/stopAll implemented with Promise.allSettled over independent hosts; no shared queue, lock, strategy switch or ordered dispatcher. Test fixture binds distinct BACKEND/FRONTEND policy subjects, descriptors, adapters and DomainExecutionInputs; barriers assert both dispatchStarted before either can complete, then one adapter rejection remains local while sibling reaches terminal. Tests: fe-be-parallel + domain-host-autonomy.

D7 — Acceptance proof matrix [AC-1..AC-8,INV-1..INV-8]. Add tests domain-activation.test.js, activation-recovery.test.js, domain-host-autonomy.test.js, frontend-domain.test.js, fe-be-parallel.test.js, partial-invalidation.test.js and run existing bb047/bb048 regressions plus npm run test:agentic. Fixtures must expose claimCalls, attemptCount, dispatchCount, dispatchStarted barriers and exact identity refs so every zero-side-effect, overlap, replay, fencing and sibling-survival assertion is directly observable. No acceptance criterion may rely on narrative-only evidence.
